items.title: Putter Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 27, 2024
items.q: it was a speech made by Cicero 2500 years ago.

ctx.x: That’s fine. Just to wrap up, are you a person who thinks about the good old days, that reminisces and thinks that things now are not nearly as positive as they used to be?

Oh of course. Of course. I’m an old man. I mean that’s the birthright of old men you know. I read this thing that said that young people today have no respect for their elders, they have no respect for like traditional ways and politeness and, I’m paraphrasing, and on and on, and it was a speech made by Cicero 2500 years ago. So there you go.
Well musically when, I don’t know if this is answerable, but musically when did the good old days start to pass?
